facts.fact: 2424.mg reports, citing the timetable shared by Djibouti Telecom, a consortium member, that the DARE1 cable will be extended with a 3,200-3,500 km segment landing in Tanzania, Mozambique, Madagascar (Mahajanga and Toliara) and South Africa (Mtunzini), with works to start in 2026 and service in 2028; no signed agreement is described.

Connecting Africa reports Djibouti Telecom announced plans to extend DARE1 (Djibouti, Somalia, Kenya, in service since 2021) by 3,200-3,500 km from Mombasa to Mtunzini, South Africa, with branches planned for Tanzania, Mozambique and Madagascar, work expected from 2026 and ready for service in 2028; no signed agreement is described.

note: as_of is the announcement 'late last week' before the 1 September 2025 publication, approximated to 29 August 2025.

facts.fact: Telma (AXIAN Telecom) stated on 10 February 2023 that the 2Africa cable, which interconnects 33 countries in Africa, Europe and the Middle East, had landed at Mahajanga in Madagascar through a Telma partnership with Vodafone, with the 2Africa East system ready for service in the fourth quarter of 2023.
